title: SSH Configuration
description: Configure SSH for secure remote management instead of Telnet.
scenario: Configure SSH for secure remote management instead of Telnet.

concepts.title: SSH vs Telnet
concepts.body: Telnet sends passwords in plaintext. SSH encrypts everything. Always use SSH for remote management.

concepts.title: SSH Requirements
concepts.body: Hostname, domain name, RSA key, local user, and VTY lines configured for SSH.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# hostname SW1
SW1(config)# ip domain-name ccna.local
SW1(config)# crypto key generate rsa

concepts.title: VTY Configuration
concepts.body: VTY lines are virtual terminal lines for remote access. Restrict them to SSH only.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# line vty 0 4
SW1(config-line)# transport input ssh
SW1(config-line)# login local
